headline: Bitcoin is holding near a four-month low after BlackRock's bitcoin fund had its biggest one-day outflow since launch, Sky's stUSDS savers are still stuck, and Anthropic trades below its first close on crypto venues.

market.asOf: Read around 08:00 UTC Fri 20 Nov (about 15:00 Bangkok) from CoinGecko. CoinGecko's own 24h figures were inconsistent; Blockchain.com showed BTC at $61,838 (-2.53%) and Binance.US $61,775 (-3.06%). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 11 out of 100 on CoinMarketCap's Fear & Greed Index (read about 08:00 UTC); the Alternative.me index could not be read this run

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near a four-month low after the biggest-ever daily outflow from BlackRock's bitcoin fund
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped to about $61,300 early Friday in Asia, its lowest since early July, as stock markets in Japan and South Korea sold off hard. Thursday's withdrawals from US bitcoin funds were nearly double Wednesday's, led by a record outflow from BlackRock's fund. When big funds pull money and leveraged traders are forced out, prices can fall fast.
points: Bitcoin's daily low was $61,273, down 10.8% over seven days, with $699.66 million of leveraged bets forced shut, per CoinGlass data reported by crypto.news.
US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $582.3 million on Thursday 19 Nov; BlackRock's IBIT lost $541.1 million, its largest daily outflow since launch, per Farside data reported by crypto.news.
November outflows from US spot bitcoin funds reached $3.47 billion, with money leaving on 12 of 14 trading days, per crypto.news.
Japan's Nikkei fell as much as 4.85% to a seven-month low and South Korea's KOSPI fell 5%, triggering a trading curb, per Bitcoin.com News.

sources.label: crypto.news: four-month low and ETF outflows

stories.title: Sky's stUSDS savers are still stuck as the founder-linked debt goes unpaid
stories.summary: Sky's high-yield stUSDS savings pool has been fully borrowed for several days, so depositors cannot take their money out. Nearly half of the borrowing sits with a wallet linked to founder Rune Christensen, and very little has been repaid. The lesson: a big yield can come with your money being locked when everyone wants out at once.
points: About $160 million of deposits are trapped; only about $420,000 has been repaid in 10 days against about $162 million owed, per Protos.
The borrow rate is about 25% a year, up from 5% last month, and the SKY token fell more than 20% in 24 hours, per Protos.
A wallet linked to Christensen owes about $77 million, about 48% of the pool's borrowing, against about $185 million of SKY tokens, per CryptoBriefing.
USDS supply fell by more than 30% to $3.2 billion after a report flagged $518 million of illicit-linked activity in Sky's swap system; USDS still traded near $1, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: USDS shrinks after illicit-finance report

stories.title: Crypto traders price Anthropic below its first close, and Binance Wallet refunds its tokenized IPO offer
stories.summary: Anthropic closed its first Nasdaq day at $97.17, and on Hyperliquid, a crypto platform that lets people bet on the stock, it was priced lower overnight. Binance Wallet's offer to get crypto users into the IPO with tokenized shares secured only a tiny number of shares, so it is giving the money back. A hot IPO does not guarantee gains for people who buy after the open, and tokenized or contract versions of a stock are not the same as owning it.
points: ANT priced at $83, opened at $111.50, hit $114.99 and closed at $97.17, per CoinDesk.
ANT contracts on Hyperliquid traded about $1.7 billion in 24 hours and were priced below the Nasdaq close in Asian hours, per CoinDesk.
Binance Wallet is refunding all the USDC locked in subscriptions in full after receiving only about 2,957 tokenized shares, per PANews.

briefs.title: Ether funds keep losing money
briefs.summary: US spot ether funds lost a net $131.2 million on 19 Nov, a fourth straight day of outflows, and $972.6 million so far in November, per Farside data reported by crypto.news.

briefs.title: VanEck drops Gemini as a custodian
briefs.summary: VanEck is removing Gemini as custodian for its bitcoin, ether and Solana funds; Coinbase stays on, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: CFTC chair on Hyperliquid and US users
briefs.summary: CFTC Chair Selig said on-chain venues like Hyperliquid can serve US retail by registering as an exchange or partnering with one, per The Block.

briefs.title: Coinbase backs the CFTC on prediction markets
briefs.summary: Coinbase filed comments supporting the CFTC's plan to treat event contracts as swaps, per The Block.

briefs.title: Court keeps stolen Binance tokens frozen
briefs.summary: An Abu Dhabi court ordered 18 firms, including Circle, to keep tokens from the 29 Oct Binance hack frozen; the firms are not accused of wrongdoing, per CoinCentral.

briefs.title: SEC charges fake crypto trading platforms
briefs.summary: The SEC charged eight Colorado entities over fake crypto platforms that took more than $37 million from US investors, per Blockchain.News.
